The job market is a mess.

But somehow the rejections are even messier.

Getting rejected after four interviews.
Losing to the mysterious "internal candidate."
Receiving a congratulations email... and then being told it was sent by mistake.

Even when it looks like you're about to get the job, you don't get the job.

In this video, we go through some of the wildest rejection emails, hiring freezes, career-gap rejections, and recruiter messages people are dealing with right now.

Because apparently getting rejected isn't enough anymo
